summary: Cross-fades an audio sample state from source A (a3) toward source B (a4) into output a5, driven by a time value a2. Clamps the time into the source range, emits an audio status event, picks discrete blend factors for out-of-range cases, otherwise computes a continuous blend. Position is interpolated with a Hermite spline (or linear blend), orientation via Euler-to-quaternion, quaternion slerp and back, and the remaining packed channels and bitfields are blended per-channel. Returns 1.

operations.description: Clamp the time value a2 into the source range [a3+4, a4+4].
ProgressBarEventEncode: emit an audio position/status event decoded from the packed bitfield header at a3.
Compute the time delta v43 = (a4+4) - (a3+4) and, when valid, its reciprocal as the blend basis.
When the time delta exceeds the 5.0 threshold, choose a discrete blend: (0.0, 1.0) when FieldCompareConstant(this) is set, otherwise (1.0, 0.0).
Within range, reject a continuous blend when the squared source-position delta scaled by the reciprocal reaches 14981.386, or when the time delta is zero; both fall back to a discrete source.
Compute the continuous blend factors v36 (from a2 relative to the source range) and v37 = 1.0 - v36.
ShortVectorToFloatWithScale: decode the packed short position of source A into a float vector.
ShortVectorToFloatWithScale: decode the packed short position of source B into a float vector.
F_3DHermiteSplineInterpolation: interpolate the position between the two sources by v36, producing the blended float vector.
Write the interpolated position to a5+8/+12/+16; the fall-through path writes the linear blend v37*A + v36*B instead.
Decode the packed short Euler angles of both sources (scaled by the 0.00048828125 short-to-angle factor) for quaternion conversion.
QuaternionFromEulerAngles: build the source A quaternion from its decoded Euler angles.
QuaternionFromEulerAngles: build the source B quaternion from its decoded Euler angles.
sub_567580: interpolate/slerp between the two quaternions by the blend factor v36.
sub_567010: convert the interpolated quaternion back to Euler angles.
Quantize the interpolated Euler angles back to 16-bit words (scale 2048.0) and write them to a5+20/+22/+24.
Blend the four-byte and four-short auxiliary channels between a3 and a4 into a5, one element per iteration, using v37 and v36.
Blend the remaining scalar channels (offsets +38/+40/+42/+44/+45/+46/+48/+50) between the sources with v37 and v36.
CRTFtol: float-to-int truncation applied to every quantized channel write in this function.
BitfieldToFloatConversion: decode the source A bitfield float for the blended re-encode.
FloatToBitfieldEncoder: re-encode the blended float value into the output bitfield.
ShortComputation_29f0: decode a packed short quantity from source A for the blended re-encode.
BitfieldInsert: insert the blended short value into the output bitfield.
BitfieldExtract: compare the raw bitfield values of source A and source B to decide between blending and selecting a single source.
BitfieldExtractScale: decode the scaled bitfield component from the selected source for re-pack.
FloatToBitfieldPack: pack the blended (or source-selected) float into the output bitfield.
Return 1 on success; the bitfield block also copies a3 or a4 payload words to a5+52/+56 depending on the blend sign.

clean_pseudocode: // a3/a4: source sample states; a5: output; a2: time; this: owner
char AudioSampleCrossFadeInterpolation(void* this, int a2, int a3, int a4, int a5) {
if (delta > 5.0) { pick discrete (v36, v37) via FieldCompareConstant(this); }
if (0 < v37 && v37 < 1) HermiteInterpolatePosition(a3, a4, v36, a5 + 8);
else LinearBlendPosition(a3, a4, v36, v37, a5 + 8);
BlendBitfields(a3, a4, a2, v36, v37, a5);
